name: Quick-Witted's stab scales with attack power and applies quiver effects (#13043)
contract: Quick-Witted 704311 (Ranger, Brigand) tooltips: avoiding an attack makes you stab an enemy with an arrow
from your quiver, dealing ${$704314m2+$704314ppl2+$AP*1} Physical damage and reducing their attack speed by
$704314s1%. Its spell_proc row fires 704314 on a dodged or parried melee hit taken. 704314 Effect1 is
SCHOOL_DAMAGE with EffectBasePoints 0, DieSides 1 and no RealPointsPerLevel, and it has no spell_bonus_data,
so #13043 reports that the stab dealt 1 damage. It is also a triggered spell, which the Ranger quiver hit
handler skipped, so the quiver's on-hit effect never followed. Expected: the stab adds 100% of melee attack
power to its 1 base damage and an active Poison Quiver (800260) applies its poison (500104) to the stabbed
enemy. Evasion (5277, +50% dodge) and 40 seconds of melee from a hostile mob make at least one avoided
attack near certain (about 20 swings at over 50% dodge). The ranger never attacks, so the poison can only
come from the stab. Armor reduces the Physical hit, so the damage floor is 30% of the ranger's attack power.
A second ranger with Searing Quiver (500103, +15% of a ranged hit as Fire Arrows 681109) checks that each
stab is followed by Fire Arrows worth about 15% of the stab (a critical Fire Arrows doubles it).
